title: Weighted approximate tangent space forces density equal to multiplicity (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(2))
statement: Let n >= 1, U an open subset of R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold), x in M, and P a linear subspace which is the approximate tangent space of M with respect to theta at x (SimonGMT HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M theta x P). Then Theta^n(mu_V, x) = theta(x), i.e. V.HasDensity x (theta x): mu_V(B_r(x)) / (omega_n r^n) -> theta(x) as r -> 0+ (in [0, infinity], with mu_V = V.weight and omega_n = unitBallVolume n).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → x ∈ V.carrier → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P → V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)
